results.summary: BW LPG reported strong Q2 2026 results with Q2 profit of US$120 million and EPS of US$0.79, driven by robust shipping performance. TCE income of US$74,000 per available day exceeded typical market rates with 53% time charter coverage at US$64,000 per day plus strong spot market exposure. Product Services generated US$127 million realised trading gain. Q3 2026 guidance is particularly strong with 92% of available days fixed at ~US$88,000 per day, significantly above prior quarters. The company raised its dividend to US$0.95 per share (100% of Shipping NPAT) and improved net leverage to 23.5% from 26.3%. Recent asset sales generated net gains and additional liquidity. The announced results reflect materially ahead performance with upgraded forward guidance for Q3.

results.headline: CARDIO inCode-Score milestone clinical results
results.key_quote: Genetic information changed the overall risk assessment in 42.6% of moderate-risk patients... Disclosing the genetic risk result to patients and clinicians was followed by measurable improvement in CV risk after a mean follow-up of 8.5 months (SD, 1.24): with a mean CV risk at recruitment to the study of 7.30% being reduced to 6.04%
results.summary: GENinCode announced milestone clinical results for its CARDIO inCode-Score CAD polygenic risk score test, presented at ESC Annual Congress 2026. The real-world pilot study of 584 patients demonstrated significant clinical utility with genetic testing changing risk assessment in 42.6% of moderate-risk patients, measurable improvement in CV risk factors (CV risk reduced from 7.30% to 6.04%, LDL-cholesterol from 136.74 to 123.17 mg/dL, smoking abstinence increased from 43.7% to 62.8%), and successful reclassification of patients for targeted prevention. Results described as providing 'major advance' in CAD prediction and showing polygenic risk acts as 'powerful risk-enhancing tool'. These represent substantial, quantified clinical validation of the test's effectiveness.

49.6% of high genetic risk group reduced to lower risk category
One in four patients changed risk category outright
Described as 'major advance' in CAD prediction

results.headline: Annual Results
results.key_quote: During the period the Company generated its first revenues of £146,046 from consulting and advisory services rendered in the United Kingdom and Canada, alongside staking income from its digital asset treasury.
results.summary: Roundhouse AI reported its first revenues of £146,046 during the 18-month period ended 31 March 2026, primarily from consulting and advisory services. The company raised approximately £1.95 million through listing on AQSE in January 2026. While the company is transitioning to AI technology focus with a platform nearing public launch expected to generate revenue within 6 months, there is no explicit comparison to market expectations, analyst forecasts, or board guidance provided in the announcement. The loss of £2.2m is attributed to non-cash charges and listing costs rather than operational performance discussion relative to expectations.
